    *   Combining with previous: $\text{Albert} \to \text{William} \to \text{Diane} \to \text{Christine} \to \text{Peter}$

5.  **Robert is Zachary's descendant.**

    *   Relationship: $\text{Zachary} \to \text{Robert}$

    *   Combining with previous: $\text{Albert} \to \text{William} \to \text{Diane} \to \text{Christine} \to \text{Peter} \to \text{Zachary} \to \text{Robert}$

    *   Combining with previous: $\text{Steven} \to \text{Albert} \to \text{William} \to \text{Diane} \to \text{Christine} \to \text{Peter} \to \text{Zachary} \to \text{Robert}$

$\text{Steven} \to \text{Albert} \to \text{William} \to \text{Diane} \to \text{Christine} \to \text{Peter} \to \text{Zachary} \to \text{Robert}$
